_note: Runtime assignment for the virtual company. Provider is NOT a property of an agent .md — the same persona can be installed into several tools. It is a property of WHERE the agent is installed, so it lives here in the company layer, never in the catalog's frontmatter. Claude Code's subagent `model:` field only accepts Claude models (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable/inherit); running an agent on GPT or Gemini means installing it into Codex or Gemini CLI via scripts/convert.sh. `scoping` records what happens to the tools:/disallowedTools: allowlist on each runtime and is derived from reading scripts/convert.sh — re-check it if the converters change. Consumed by company/ui/build.py, which joins label/short/accent from the repo's tools.json so this file never duplicates tool metadata.

_scoping.enforced: Native format; Claude Code documents tools:/disallowedTools: and enforces them.
_scoping.carried: The converter writes a tools: field (or copies the file verbatim), but whether that runtime enforces it is UNVERIFIED — do not rely on it for isolation.
_scoping.dropped: scripts/convert.sh provably omits tools: for this format. Role scoping does not survive. An agent with a tool allowlist loses it here.

_assignments_note: slug -> { runtime, model?, note? }. Empty means every agent runs on the company default. These are DECLARED INTENT: nothing installs from this file yet — Stage 2 of company/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md is what makes it executable. `model` only means anything on claude-code (opus | sonnet | haiku | fable | inherit).
